input: Physical W93/W95/W96/W97 downloaded preview photos inspected on fixed ~390 CSS pixel width with object-fit:contain and vertical limit 500px

methodology.imageTreatment: object-fit:contain; no crop, 100% painted composition if present

statuses.subject: Saint Alphonsus Liguori
statuses.evidence: W95: Marini 1045x1280 and Lenzi 742x1065 both monochrome and framed; visible but weak devotional colour/fidelity
statuses.next: Colour source of same original(s), not more pixels

statuses.subject: Saint Peter Damian
statuses.evidence: W95: G30-007 overall 853x1280 framed, severe low exposure; G30-006 989x1480 monochrome; G30-007 second 1280x853 file is a detail crop and fails full-picture
statuses.next: Correctly exposed colour image of exact selected painting

statuses.subject: Saint Robert Bellarmine
statuses.evidence: W95 578x768: figure readable at 390px but black-and-white, unsuitable if a colour painting reproduction can be found; pixel count is NOT rejection reason
statuses.next: Find original full-colour photograph; B&W permitted only as explicit last-resort editorial exception

statuses.subject: Saint Louis IX
statuses.evidence: W93 Louvre/Nancy 999x1500: colour composition readable at 390px, despite prominent external frame and faded/soft rendition
statuses.next: May prepare trim-to-painted-edge derivative, never crop painting; verify reuse rights and physical original attribution

statuses.subject: Saint Margaret Mary Alacoque
statuses.evidence: W98 actual download 800x600: clear balanced colour, depiction instantly legible at 390 CSS px, no noticeable mobile pixel deficit. Commons photographic credits include uploader CC BY-SA 4.0 despite the auto API reporting public domain; exact Podesti/Vatican inventory still unverified.
statuses.next: Confirm physical painting attribution/custodian and record CC BY-SA 4.0 conditions; no more resolution hunting

statuses.subject: Saint Denis of Paris
statuses.evidence: W95 609x700: full composition depicts kneeling bishop with executioner, readable and colour-visible at 390px; faded photo but no pixel issue
statuses.next: Check full painting original accession and photo reuse rights, optional colour balance of derivative

statuses.subject: Our Lady of Perpetual Help
statuses.evidence: W98 source file PerpetualExact.jpg 397x499 explicitly reports self-photographed actual original Roman icon 2009, renders recognisably at 390 CSS px; CC BY-SA 3.0. Alternative Perpetual help original icon.jpg 500x609 renders softer/more attractive but physical original provenance weaker. The previously cited 781x1024 'original' is a monochrome mosaic depiction and must be excluded.
statuses.next: Keep both colour images separate; verify full icon identity and quality/rights; block 781x1024 mosaic from selected original master

statuses.subject: Seven Sorrows of Mary
statuses.evidence: W92 Munich Van Dyck 3750x2736 and W96 Bilbao Van Dyck 6306x3784: two separate colourful full-scene works, mobile-legible
statuses.next: Reconcile existing unaccessioned selection, do not acquire further copies just for resolution

statuses.subject: Most Holy Trinity
statuses.evidence: W92 KMSKA Rubens 3840x3949 is full artwork; W96 Basel Rubens 1160x1624 mobile-legible, despite smaller pixels
statuses.next: Reconcile physical artwork ID; museum/photographer terms tracked individually

statuses.subject: Cain and Abel
statuses.evidence: W97 Courtauld Rubens 7045x9694 visually strong at 390px; Courtauld CC BY-NC versus Commons PD-Art unresolved for commercial app
statuses.next: Resolve rights conflict and selected original, not image resolution

statuses.subject: Melchizedek Blesses Abram
statuses.evidence: W97 NGA Rubens 4000x3193 vibrant/legible at phone width, CC0 museum original
statuses.next: Only legacy physical original/curator selection reconciliation required

conclusion: Completed phone-size visual triage on all 11 photo-available gaps. 8 have mobile-suitable pictures worth working from (4 previously acquired high-quality originals, 4 smaller mobile-adequate candidates); 3 require a better colour photograph. All strict source/rights/curator gates remain independent.

mobileBatchResult.warning: Visual legibility is NOT equivalent to original-identity or reuse-rights clearance
